HERO_HEADLINE: Trusted counsel when it matters most
HERO_SUBHEADLINE: Clear advice, steady guidance, and a team that fights for your outcome. We handle the details so you can move forward.
FEATURE_1_DESCRIPTION: You get plain-language updates and a lawyer who returns your calls.
FEATURE_2_DESCRIPTION: Years of favorable outcomes for clients in situations like yours.
FEATURE_3_DESCRIPTION: Your case is handled by a senior attorney, not passed down the hall.
FEATURE_4_DESCRIPTION: Your matter stays private, handled with care at every step.
FEATURE_5_DESCRIPTION: You know the structure up front, with no surprise bills.
FEATURE_6_DESCRIPTION: Questions answered quickly, because timing often matters.
SERVICES_SUBHEADLINE: Focused, experienced representation across the matters families and businesses face most.
SERVICE_1_FULL_DESCRIPTION: Divorce, custody, and support handled with discretion and care. We protect what matters most to you.
SERVICE_2_FULL_DESCRIPTION: Wills, trusts, and powers of attorney that give your family clarity and peace of mind.
SERVICE_3_FULL_DESCRIPTION: If you were hurt by someone else, we pursue the full recovery you deserve. No fee unless we win.
SERVICE_4_FULL_DESCRIPTION: Formation, contracts, and disputes handled so you can run your company with confidence.
SERVICE_5_FULL_DESCRIPTION: Smooth closings and clear contracts for buyers, sellers, and owners.
SERVICE_6_FULL_DESCRIPTION: Compassionate guidance through probate and the settling of an estate.
SERVICES_CTA_DESCRIPTION: Book a free consultation and get a clear, honest read on your options.
PROCESS_1_DESCRIPTION: Tell us your situation in a free, confidential meeting.
PROCESS_2_DESCRIPTION: We map a clear plan and explain every option.
PROCESS_3_DESCRIPTION: We handle the filings, negotiations, and hard conversations.
PROCESS_4_DESCRIPTION: We pursue the strongest outcome and keep you informed throughout.
FAQ_SUBHEADLINE: What to expect when you work with our firm.
FAQ_1_Q: How much does a consultation cost?
FAQ_1_A: Your initial consultation is free. We will review your situation and explain your options with no obligation.
FAQ_2_A: It depends on the matter. Many cases are flat-fee or contingency, and we explain the structure clearly up front.
FAQ_3_Q: How long will my case take?
FAQ_3_A: Every matter is different, but we give you a realistic timeline early and keep you updated at each step.
FAQ_4_Q: Will I work with the same attorney?
FAQ_4_A: Yes. A senior attorney handles your case directly, so you always speak with someone who knows the details.
